rationale: A broken import that fails the web build; not among AACR-Bench's references, found by ocra in two runs.

expect.concern: languageOptions is imported from @/locales/config, which does not export it, and nothing in the web app defines it, so the build fails.
Missing translation keys for 'avatarHidden' and 'locale' in chat namespace

adjudicated.label: valid
adjudicated.reason: Real: the chat namespace defines neither avatarHidden nor locale in any locale file, so the form shows raw keys (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: Missing translation keys for 'avatarHidden' and 'locale' in chat namespace
